route_axis_contract.rule: Threat-model scope, substrate decision disposition, and Engine evidence are independent axes.

trust_boundary.creative_output: A generated seed or proposer-authored mechanism is untrusted research input. It may be novel, mistaken, duplicated, or merely a renamed representation.
trust_boundary.deterministic_engine: The deterministic layer checks provenance, scope, exact required fields, known-premise fingerprints, review coverage, and authorization boundaries. It does not prove mathematical novelty or truth.
trust_boundary.quality_claim: Quality-cleared means that every declared hard gate and five-role review gate passed for the exact proposal digest. It does not mean the hypothesis is true, novel in all literature, or likely to break ECDLP.
trust_boundary.authorization_boundary: This layer never authorizes an experiment, promotes a route, targets secp256k1 directly, or makes an asymptotic claim.

typed_evidence.authorization_boundary: Typed cells and desk decisions authorize nothing. Only an open cell may seed an untrusted proposal, and every later experiment and promotion gate remains separate.

seed_coverage.rule: An overflow is materialized rather than hidden or treated as a generation failure. Every seed remains non-executable; the coverage artifact must be reviewed before a later cycle may change the threshold or synthesis partition.

seed_lifecycle.rule: A frozen legacy id resolves to current state only while its scoped scientific identity is unchanged; otherwise it is a historical-only snapshot and cannot quality-clear.

typed_cell.construction: Find an auxiliary curve E0 over the same field whose order contains a B-smooth factor near p to the one-over-m scale; use the kernel self-isogeny on E0 to construct the composed root map L for target-curve factor-base coordinates.
typed_cell.relation_action: The original target curve remains the relation group. The auxiliary self-isogeny defines only the root set and low-degree decomposition of L; all recovered x-values must still lift to valid target-curve points and relations.
typed_cell.changed_quantity: Auxiliary-curve search, composed-map construction, generalized-root solving, recovery, and total relation-generation cost.

cost_quantity.label: Generalized root-finding and recovery cost
cost_quantity.definition: Cost of solving the composed-map fiber constraints and recovering valid factor-base points without hidden discarded components.
cost_quantity.baseline: Direct factor-base membership and relation recovery at the same arity and effective factor-base size.
cost_quantity.measurement: Price all roots, spurious fibers, recovery failures, preprocessing, and independent relation validation as field size grows.

requirement_results.rationale: The construction cannot proceed until an explicit auxiliary-curve instance over the shared field is constructed and its complete cost is recorded.

typed_cell.boundary: The first output is a bounded arithmetic construction or no-instance record plus a complete precomputation estimate, not an ECDLP experiment.

target_feature.statement: Petit-style factor bases define x-coordinates through a low-degree composition, creating structured fibers whose relation yield and generalized root-solving cost can be measured independently.
target_feature.boundary: A smaller coordinate image or a successful toy solve is not a complexity improvement unless recovery, exceptional fibers, preprocessing, and total relation cost are all included.

mechanism_primitive.statement: Exploit a composed rational map only through an algorithm that enumerates or samples valid fibers, recovers curve points, prices excluded components, and returns independently checkable relations.
mechanism_primitive.boundary: The construction remains a proposal primitive until its generalized root problem and all offline work are cheaper than the matched plain presentation at increasing toy sizes.

unresolved_question.statement: The faithful Petit-style route has no validated algorithm showing that generalized root finding plus recovery and preprocessing beats the matched plain factor-base pipeline as field size grows.
unresolved_question.boundary: Approximate or nonfaithful variants and isolated toy wins do not answer the faithful generalized-root question.

typed_cell.construction: Specialize the published chain to L1(x)=x^2, L2(x)=x^3, L3(x)=x^7, and L4(x)=1-x^13441, so L=1-x^564522. At arity sixteen and a nonidentity affine target, direct source System (4) has 64 factor coordinates and 65 equation members. The available divisor clears the raw and source-yield thresholds, but the repository contributes only a target-bound sound acceptance filter; complete recovery and complete cost remain open, and identity samples require separate handling.
typed_cell.relation_action: The construction clears both arithmetic predicates only by moving to a high-arity Semaev relation. For nonsingular y^2=x^3+7 in characteristic not in {2,3,7}, TASK-017 fixes the exact set-theoretic projective S3-tree semantics, every named exceptional fiber, supplied-coordinate recovery, and GLV lift signs. TASK-018 freezes the recursive projective S17 contract with fixed degrees and the literal Sylvester determinant under the frozen coefficient, argument, and row order. TASK-019 kernel-checks the fixed-degree projective resultant common-root theorem, the literal TASK-018 Sylvester matrix and determinant with coefficient unit 1, and the end-to-end common-root corollary while retaining formal-degree drops, zero forms, affine witnesses, and [1:0]. TASK-020 kernel-checks the actual frozenC family, exact coefficient-map specialization with unit 1 and affine and [1:0] output branches, the universal output-degree bound, and the unconditional one-step common-projective-root equivalence. TASK-021 kernel-checks the exact declared-degree projective evaluation bridges and the universal all-stage frozen witness-chain equivalence, including the C16 chain with fourteen intermediate projective slots and infinity allowed at every level. TASK-022 kernel-checks the exact literal finite MvPolynomial family for the frozen stage-14 predicate after injective base change: one GuardVar assignment satisfies every GuardedEquation, with fourteen raw projective slots, 56 scalar variables, fifteen H equations, fourteen guards, and total degree at most four. It is equivalent to the recursive chain, not a parallel recursive syntax. TASK-023 kernel-checks the exact affine/infinity chart-polynomial cover. Each fixed InfinityMask I has exactly 14 - I.card affine scalar variables, no guard equations, and fifteen literal H equations with degree ceilings 2/4/2; the cover is equivalent to the chain, guarded system, and source predicate after base change. TASK-024 kernel-checks necessary infinity-stratum pruning: affine external inputs restrict the exact cover from 16384 masks to 987 separated masks, while nonzero endpoint determinants conditionally restrict it to 377 interior masks. Isolated infinity slots force existing affine neighbors to q.u / q.v. TASK-025 kernel-checks the nested local reductions 377 to 129 to 69 to 36, with the independent boundary-only branch 129 to 60, and proves over any field that an internal infinity forces an explicit frozen prefix or suffix obstruction to vanish. Under affine inputs, endpoint nonvanishing, and BalancedPropagatedRegular (the twelve balanced obstruction nonvanishing conditions), every solution uses the empty mask and the exact chart cover is the single affine chart. The source-stage bridge additionally assumes injective base change into an algebraically closed target and balanced regularity for the mapped target data; source-field computation does not automatically establish that mapped-target regularity. The remaining mechanism gap is symbolic nonzeroness and nonemptiness of a usable regular locus or orchestration of its exceptional complement, together with usable relation yield and rank, solving, recovery, and total cost.

typed_cell.boundary: This open desk-cost cell has exact input presentations, an exact set-theoretic projective-tree bridge on the stated nonsingular characteristic domain, a complete named exceptional-fiber classification, deterministic control and secp256k1 GLV recovery checks, a frozen recursive projective S17 contract, kernel-checked fixed-degree projective resultant plus literal Sylvester unit-one and end-to-end common-root theorems, the actual frozenC specialization, the exact all-stage frozen projective witness chain, an exact literal finite MvPolynomial family in guarded form, an exact affine/infinity chart-polynomial cover for the frozen stage-14 predicate after injective base change, exact necessary infinity-stratum pruning, and exact conditional infinity propagation. Each fixed InfinityMask I uses 14 - I.card affine variables, no guard equations, and fifteen H equations with degree ceilings 2/4/2; the existential cover is exact and retains [1:0]. Affine external inputs reduce the exact logical cover from 16384 masks to 987 separated masks, and nonzero endpoint determinants conditionally reduce it to 377 interior masks. TASK-025 gives the nested local reductions 377 to 129 to 69 to 36 and the independent boundary-only branch 129 to 60. Under endpoint and BalancedPropagatedRegular assumptions it proves an exact single empty-mask affine chart, not a unique witness. The direct propagation applies over any field, but the source-stage bridge still requires injective base change into an algebraically closed target and separately assumed mapped-target regularity. Symbolic nonzeroness, nonemptiness, density, probability, and genericity are not proved, and source-field computation does not automatically establish mapped regularity. The 2^14 logical masks are not enumerated or materialized, and neither are the pruned families. It is not an expanded direct S17 polynomial, an unconditional base-field descent theorem, a solver run, or evidence of independent dimensions or relations. The complete cost bridge remains open. CQ-SEMAEV-S17-SYSTEM-COST remains partial; solving cost, rank, and yield remain unpriced. The scoped result has zero_retention_success and does not justify a production mask sweep, solver run, target computation, hypothesis retention, experiment authorization, cost inference, route rejection, or route promotion.
